insert:
id:stateBar
property bool compactActive: false
width: 480
height: 12
color : viewstyle.bgcolor.D1
property bool isEnableStatusBarMouseArea
property var stateIconList
signal statusBarClicked()
Row{
readonly property string iconQmlPath: "icon/"
readonly property var iconQml:["","StatusIcon.qml","VolumeIcon.qml","VolumeChangeIcon.qml","BatteryRemainingNumIcon.qml","BatteryRemainingImageIcon.qml"]
id:row
Repeater {
id:repeater
model:stateIconList
Loader{
id:loader
objectName: "nativeStatusSlot"
property string movedName: String(ParamAnimationImageRole)
property bool hiddenPlayback: stateBar.compactActive && qmlNum === 1 &&
/^stat_notify_audio_track_(play|pause|(just_)?(rewind|fast_forward)|next|previous)\.png$/.test(movedName)
property bool moved: stateBar.compactActive && qmlNum === 1 && Number(ParamIntFrameSize) > 0 &&
(movedName === "stat_sys_bluetooth.png" || movedName === "stat_sys_nfc.png" || /^stat_sys_battery_[a-z0-9_]+\.png$/.test(movedName))
property int qmlNum:QmlIntRole+0
height:stateBar.height
width:ParamIntFrameSize
source:!moved && !hiddenPlayback && ( 1 <= qmlNum && 5 >= qmlNum ) ? row.iconQmlPath + row.iconQml[qmlNum]:""
Binding{
target:loader.item
when:loader.status == Loader.Ready
property:'animationImage'
value:ParamAnimationImageRole
